data.title: 吹雪 · 海滨俱乐部的冰镇提案
data.description: 吹雪穿着祖母绿连体泳装坐在遮阳篷下，桌上摆着冰镇饮料与一份被海风吹乱的企划；她按住纸张后抬眼微笑，仿佛连度假也能变成一场优雅而有利的谈判。
data.action: 遮阳篷下按住被风吹乱的企划与冰饮，抬眼把度假变成优雅谈判
data.lighting: warm afternoon light under a striped canopy
data.mood: 连海风都被她纳入行程管理
data.promptProse: She pins the windblown proposal against the table beside the chilled drink and looks up toward the viewer; afternoon light filtered through the canopy softens her composed smile.
data.animaCaption: She pins the windblown proposal against the table beside the chilled drink and looks up.
